split_policy: 18 train / 5 calibration / 5 development LibriSpeech speakers sorted by SHA256(seed+speaker); 70/15/15 percent unique noise recording hashes; all windows from a recording remain together
data_limitations: Development reused during search; no final holdout measurement.
Read English speech, not medical or field validation.
measurement_limitations: Pretrained comparison overlapped CUDA training on the same host; timing is exploratory and not an isolated efficiency benchmark.
CPU package and iPhone energy unavailable. No power-saving conclusion.
24 unique speech utterances in two conditions and 24 noise-only recordings; repetitions are not independent samples.
Old full-clip gate thresholds were transferred unchanged to one-second windows.
Literal scoring preserves digits rather than equating number formatting with spelled numbers.
